uk_spelling_review.scope: Authored paragraph.text, figure.caption and table.note narrative and companion prose. Reference titles, technical identifiers, frozen figure image wording, table cells, and protected declaration block136 are excluded.
uk_spelling_review.convention: UK labelled, favourable/favoured, behaviour and colour; Oxford -ize/-ization forms are accepted British spellings. Existing source-normalized and related technical model labels remain unchanged.
documented_protected_exceptions: manuscript_content.json blocks[136].text / manuscript_en.md Data and code availability retains noun licenses under declaration preservation.
Frozen Table 2 cell retains target-person labeled training trials.
Cited article titles, archived pipeline identifiers and frozen scientific image wording retain original spellings.

scope: Agent-assisted review of current delivered PDF layout and DOCX OOXML structure after final ordinary-prose spelling and supplementary title-presentation refresh. Only layout_review.json and layout_review.md were written in the paper tree. No manuscript, figures, scientific result artifacts, EEG data, model fitting, raw-data processing, or inference was edited or executed by this review.
reviewer: Codex assistant visual inspection using view_image, supported by PyMuPDF text/bounds and python-docx OOXML checks; no human editorial review is claimed.

sample_visual_findings: All current PDF page layouts were inspected in contact sheets. No page-edge text/image crop, box clipping, table-cell loss, or figure/caption separation was observed.

Figure 1 p4 contains three rows and nine complete boxes with baseline-relative μ/β power, event/class eligibility, ground-truth scoring-only and no-target-fitting/model-selection labels; arrows and boundary annotations remain visible.
Figure 6 p20 preserves A–F panel headings, μ/β frequencies, C3/Cz/C4 sensor labels, hand legend, task/baseline dB axes and colour-bar limits.

Figure S3 supplementary p8 / combined p32 contains all six μ/β model panels, axis units, Spearman coefficients and all nine participant IDs. Adjacent point IDs are tightly spaced in a few panels but remain visible; no missing glyph or clipped label was seen.
Supplementary p8 reproduced Companion title now has no literal Markdown asterisks. All title words remain present.

Main title and p24 contribution/AI declarations, and both cover-letter pages, show complete author/contact/postal details. Cover-letter ethics sentence continues across its page break, with all text present.

informational: Three hand-power table grids (main Table 8, combined Table 8 and supplementary Methods table M1) round to 9545 twips against 9544 twips printable width, a 1-twip (~0.018 mm) metadata excess. No visual clipping was observed.
Main/combined/supplementary PDF pages are 597.6 × 842.4 pt (8.3 × 11.7 in). Cover PDF is 595.276 × 841.890 pt. All DOCX sections declare A4.
The current main last page 26 contains references [26]–[28]; combined p33 contains [9]–[28]; supplementary p18 contains [18]–[28]. The last reference is not alone on a page.
limitations: DOCX checks concern OOXML structure and exported-text presence. Microsoft Word/LibreOffice rendered pagination, clipping and refreshed PAGE field values were not observed.
This review does not verify native TeX compilation. It checks the delivered PDF/DOCX artifacts.
No independent scientific/numerical validation was performed here. Figure/table text presence and labels are rendering checks; the separate numerical audit remains authoritative.
Visual inspection was performed by the assistant from contact sheets and the explicitly listed enlarged samples; it is not human copy-editing or a claim of exhaustive full-resolution proofing.

The UK narrative check follows the declared convention and protected exclusions. It is not a certification that protected declarations, table cells, cited titles or frozen figure wording use uniform house spelling.
